```
    odd_count = {0: 0, 1: 1}

        even_count[(x | x ^ 1) & 1] -= 1
        odd_count[(x | x ^ 1) & 1] += 1
    return even_count[0], odd_count[0]

def find_bit_pos(num, mask):
    mask_position = num.bit_length()
    while mask_position >= 0 and not (mask << mask_position) & mask:
        mask_position -= 1
    return mask_position
```

```
def is_inertial(arr):
    # Check condition a: at least one odd value
    has_odd = any(val % 2 for val in arr)
    if not has_odd:
        return False

    # Check condition b: maximum value is even
    max_val = max(arr)
    if max_val % 2 != 0:
        return False

    # Check condition c: all odd values > all even vals that aren't max
    odd_vals = [val for val in arr if val % 2 != 0]
    max_odd_index = arr.index(max_val)
    even_vals = [val for val in arr if val % 2 == 0 and val != max_val]

    for odd_val in odd_vals:
        for even_val in even_vals:
            if odd_val <= even_val:
                return False

    return True
```
</solution>
